title: David Choe Interview - myFinBec 2013, Graffiti Art & Wine Documentary
description: The 2013 myFinBec documentary follows Choe painting wooden wine crates and labels, beginning with travel-ban jokes, adapting imagery to bottles viewed sideways, embracing paint-warped wood and ending with the producer's account of packing artist-designed wine.
